transcript_or_text: As someone who exercises six days per week, I've learned that recovery is just as important to me as the workout itself. I train hard, and I've learned that if I don't recover properly, I feel it. That's why the sauna has been a huge part of my recovery for the last few years. I notice that I'm sore for a much shorter period of time, and I recover way faster when I'm in the sauna consistently. And now with Peak saunas, I can get that recovery right at home. Their infrared saunas actually get hot, and they're made with top-tier materials, and they even include a wellness club with guided heat recovery, and wellness routines. For me, sauna isn't just relaxation, it's recovery.
